newsitem.title: UK: LME copper nudges above $2,350 in late trading.
newsitem.headline: LME copper nudges above $2,350 in late trading.

text.p: LME copper edged higher in late inter-office trading on Thursday, making headway above the $2,350 resistance area.
At 1910 GMT, three months copper was quoted at $2,357/62 per tonne, up from $2,351.50 at the afternoon kerb close.
This brings prices above the 10-day moving average, chartists said.
The market expects a modest draw in copper stocks on Friday, one trader said.
The other metals were little moved.
